ideas.name: Raise ranged weapon persona constitution minimums
ideas.hypothesis: The AI stat allocator fills minimumTargets first. Ranged personas have constitution min 5-6 vs melee 6-7. AvgMinHP of 45-46% for ranged vs 71-75% for melee indicates HP starvation. Each constitution point adds 10 HP (base HP 100). Raising bow/pistol 5→7 and throwing-knife 6→7 adds 20 HP (+13%), closing the survivability gap. Side effect: also biases gear scoring toward constitution items (auto-progression.ts) — treated as intentional combined persona treatment.
ideas.telemetryEvidence: Clear correlation: melee (con min 6-7) → 92-100% win rate; ranged (con min 5-6) → 72-76% win rate. All three ranged weapons show AvgMinHP ~45-47% vs melee 71-75%.
ideas.change: bow minimumTargets.constitution: 5→7; pistol minimumTargets.constitution: 5→7; throwing-knife minimumTargets.constitution: 6→7

ideas.name: Increase player invincibility frames (250ms→350ms)
ideas.hypothesis: Player invincibility window prevents stacking damage from multiple hits. Deaths at lv3-4 (120-153s) occur during dense early enemy packs. Extending iframes from 250→350ms (40% increase) breaks damage-stacking chains from rats/slimes. Applies to all weapons but benefits ranged more (lower HP from lower constitution makes each hit more lethal relative to HP pool). Change is in damageSystem.ts PLAYER_INVINCIBILITY_MS constant (NOT tuning.json, which is not read by combat systems).
ideas.telemetryEvidence: Early deaths at seeds 12/48/52 at lv3-4, 120-153s — timing consistent with dense early-game mob packs before HP pool is built up.

ideas.name: Reduce Rat Brute contact damage (10→7)
ideas.hypothesis: Rat Brutes appear 15% of passive spawns and 40% of defensive spawns from Rats Nest. Their contact damage of 10 (2.5× regular rat) causes spiky damage events during early-game clearing. Reducing from 10→7 (30% reduction) makes them still notably dangerous but less likely to cause one-two-punch kills. This targets an actual Floor 1 mob rather than the DEFAULT_CONTACT_DAMAGE fallback (which only applies to enemies without an explicit Damage component — not any real Floor 1 mob).
ideas.telemetryEvidence: Early deaths at lv3-4 in Rats Nest encounters. Regular rat (4 contact) is manageable; brute (10) is 2.5× per-hit. With con 5 player (150 HP), a brute hit is 6.7% HP — very punishing in swarms.

combinedSweep.strategy: All 3 ideas implemented cumulatively; each subsequent sweep includes all accepted prior changes. This allows marginal-contribution judgment for each idea while keeping the branch in a single shippable state.
